criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Part of
categories.definition: Entity X is a component, member, or subset of the larger entity Y.

categories.name: Located in
categories.definition: Entity X is geographically situated within the boundaries of place Y.

categories.name: Creator
categories.definition: Entity X is the author, artist, director, or originator of the creative work Y.

categories.name: Publisher
categories.definition: Entity X released, distributed, or produced the work, product, or entity Y.

categories.name: Occupation
categories.definition: Entity X is the professional role, job title, or career field of person Y.

categories.name: Affiliation
categories.definition: Entity X is an organization, team, or group that person Y is associated with.

categories.name: Event participation
categories.definition: Entity X is an event, competition, or tournament in which entity Y participated.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: Entity X is a relative (parent, sibling, spouse, etc.) of entity Y.

categories.name: Award nomination
categories.definition: Entity X is an award or prize for which entity Y was nominated or won.

categories.name: Tributary
categories.definition: Entity X is a river or stream that flows into the larger river or body of water Y.

categories.name: Nationality
categories.definition: Entity X is the country of origin, citizenship, or ethnic identity associated with entity Y.

categories.name: Adaptation source
categories.definition: Entity X is the original work, story, or person that inspired the adaptation Y.

categories.name: Genre
categories.definition: Entity X is the artistic style, category, or genre to which work Y belongs.

categories.name: Owner
categories.definition: Entity X is the owner, parent company, or acquirer of entity Y.

categories.name: Administrative division
categories.definition: Entity X is a geographical region or district that governs or contains entity Y.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Entity X is the language used in, spoken in, or associated with entity Y.

categories.name: Synonym
categories.definition: Entity X and entity Y are different names or terms referring to the same concept or entity.

categories.name: Platform
categories.definition: Entity X is the hardware, operating system, or platform on which software Y runs.

categories.name: Character
categories.definition: Entity X is a fictional character appearing in the creative work Y.

categories.name: Position held
categories.definition: Entity X is a political office, title, or position held by person Y.

categories.name: Time of event
categories.definition: Entity X is a specific date, year, or time period when the event Y occurred.

categories.name: Taxonomic rank
categories.definition: Entity X is the biological classification rank (e.g., family, order) of organism Y.

categories.name: Serves
categories.definition: Entity X is a facility or service that supports or provides access to the location Y.

categories.name: Named after
categories.definition: Entity X was named in honor of or to reference entity Y.

categories.name: Variant
categories.definition: Entity X is a variation, version, or derivative of entity Y.
